scientific_question: Does the presence-opportunity signature observed prospectively in the 5-12-presence layer replicate in an even rarer, previously unread 1-4-presence species layer?

primary_presence_opportunity.future_estimand: equal-weight mean across heldout blocks containing at least one realized presence of C-minus-R3 log loss among y=1 cells

secondary_absence_signature.future_estimand: equal-weight mean C-minus-R3 among y=0 cells
secondary_absence_signature.role: secondary; cannot rescue failed presence primary

secondary_external_isolation_attenuation.future_estimand: Spearman rho across presence-bearing heldout blocks between block-mean presence-cell C-minus-R3 and response-independent Current_isolation
secondary_external_isolation_attenuation.prediction: positive, meaning the presence benefit becomes less negative at greater external isolation
secondary_external_isolation_attenuation.role: separate secondary; cannot rescue failed presence primary

secondary_source_support.future_estimand: within blocks containing both support classes, mean presence-cell C-minus-R3 for graph-nonempty minus graph-empty cells
secondary_source_support.role: secondary; cannot rescue failed presence primary

layer_rule.rare96_disjointness: sealed rare layer required pilot presence 5-12
layer_rule.if_fewer_than_minimum: terminal NOT_ESTIMABLE; do not widen the presence range after census

next_step_if_gate_passes: freeze exact R3/C predictions, graph-empty mask, and response-independent block Current_isolation before any ultrarare heldout value is decoded
